scope: Extend the repeated binary task boundary to a fixed positive power below one, under Gaussian attribute blocks and independent fair choice labels.

paired_simulation.slope_ratio: Round the midpoint of the two analytic numerical boundaries for correlations 0 and 0.99 to three decimals. Freeze the ratio before generating any simulation outcomes.
paired_simulation.ordinary_comparator: Original zero-power human-choice logit, classify both designs.
paired_simulation.independent_check: Recompute the candidate margin directly in original probability coordinates for the first eight paired allocations per sample size and correlation.
